claims.statement: feature-intake is a hard gate: no edit, scaffold, or implementation dispatch may occur until Lane and Confidence are recorded in specs/<slug>/SUMMARY.md, and the user is never asked to classify risk.

Intake lane assignment: a manifest hard gate is high-risk; otherwise 0–1 risk flags is tiny only for one-file/no-new-public-callable work (else normal), 2–3 flags is normal, 4+ is high-risk; a human may lower a hard-gated lane only by narrowing scope.

feature-intake sends an Input-type: bug fix to diagnosing-bugs (read via the Read tool, not the Skill tool) before the lane route, then routes tiny to branch-and-direct-patch with quick-check proof, normal to using-git-worktrees then subagent-driven-development, and high-risk to brainstorming, xia2, writing-plans, using-git-worktrees, subagent-driven-development, with compound for durable decisions.

For a new SUMMARY, intake initializes the durable run as investigating then planning for normal and high-risk lanes, run-state failures never block intake, and verify_summary.py --lane runs before handoff.

When drafting intent, only a tiny + high-confidence classification is auto-approved; other results stop and ask for approval, and committing intent on main/master first cuts a <type>/<slug> branch so the shared branch gets no commit.

Escalation to specs/<slug>/ESCALATIONS.md occurs on an un-narrowed hard gate, low confidence (or medium on high-risk), ambiguous direction, in-flight triggers, or system-redefining changes; otherwise high-confidence normal work is notify-and-proceed, and ESCALATIONS.md is deny-on-no-response enforced by check_escalations in commit-gate.

brainstorming produces an approved specs/<slug>/design.md, forbids code, scaffolding, or implementation skills before user approval, and its only valid terminal handoff is xia2 followed by writing-plans.

xia2 writes only specs/<slug>/research-brief.md until delivered, maps depth from the intake lane (high-risk Deep, normal Standard, tiny Quick only if all Quick conditions pass), may raise but never lower depth, and requires upstream/docs research based on external surface rather than depth alone.

writing-plans requires design.md and research-brief.md, validates PLAN.md with check_plan_contract.py, runs render_plan.py --summarize, and hands off to using-git-worktrees (unless already isolated) then subagent-driven-development in the same session without asking the user to confirm start.

using-git-worktrees first runs detect-isolation.sh, which classifies the checkout as submodule, linked-worktree (git dir differs from common dir), or main-worktree, and creates isolation only from main-worktree, preferring the native EnterWorktree tool under .claude/worktrees/.

If intake already cut <type>/<slug>, using-git-worktrees switches the main checkout to base and adopts that branch in the worktree via git reset --keep and git branch -M; otherwise it renames the tool's worktree-<name> branch and resets to base before any edit if HEAD differs.
Inside the workspace, using-git-worktrees deploys the harness with scripts/deploy-harness.sh and runs the project's clean baseline, reporting pre-existing failures before implementation.

branch-isolation-guard.sh denies Write/Edit outside specs/ when the owning checkout is on a shared branch (HARNESS_SHARED_BRANCHES, default main master) with no lane exemption, with BRANCH_ISOLATION_REASON as a logged break-glass.

subagent-driven-development advances a task only after its Verify and both per-task reviewer verdicts (spec and quality) are green, sets the plan active and run implementing at start, and moves the run to verifying before the final review chain.

Under subagent-driven-development the implementer returns its contract inline and the controller transcribes it verbatim to .harness-state/sdd/report-<task>.md, because the runtime refuses subagent report-file writes.

The final review chain runs diagnosing-bugs Phase 6 first for a diagnosed bug fix, then context-propagation-audit only for workflow-engine diffs, then correctness-review and intent-review over one shared BASE..HEAD package; a .review-receipt.json at reviewed HEAD with zero blocking findings plus verify_summary.py --check is required for handoff and any later code commit invalidates the receipt.
compound runs only when a reusable learning or Harness-Delta backlog signal exists, not merely because a session ended, and always ends by running scripts/rebuild_solution_index.py.

resolve_finish_context.py derives the slug from the branch after the first '/', defaults base to main, and resolves the plan by exact specs/<slug>/PLAN.md, then a unique direct slug match, then a unique best token-overlap match of at least 2, reporting ambiguous_plan when multiple candidates tie.

resolve_finish_context.py reads lane from the plan's sibling SUMMARY.md, lists changed files from merge-base..HEAD, sets receipt_path to <plan_dir>/.review-receipt.json, and flags context_propagation_audit_required when a changed skills/, agents/, or rules/ path is markdown or under subagents/ or prompts/.

finishing-a-development-branch asks the user on plan ambiguity, uses a tiny/no-plan path when no plan exists, never pushes failing tests, and for non-tiny planned work requires check_review_receipt.py --require correctness,intent --require-audit-if <base>, re-run immediately before push.
Before pushing, the finish flow marks the plan status: shipped, re-renders the At-a-glance block, and commits PLAN.md, SUMMARY.md, RUN.json and events.jsonl staged by name.

After opening the PR, finishing transitions the run to ready_to_merge non-fatally and commits/pushes the RUN.json/events.jsonl change, because shipped is legal only from ready_to_merge and a run left at verifying would never terminalize.
finishing-a-development-branch only creates a PR: it never merges, force-pushes, uses git add -A or git clean, discards work, or amends commits; a human reviews and merges.

Artifact policy: SUMMARY.md is written in every lane, while PLAN.md (>3 steps or >2 files), research-brief.md (unfamiliar code or high-risk), and design.md (real design fork or high-risk) are signal-triggered; FULL_ARTIFACTS=1 forces the full set.
skills/README.md exists and declares itself the single source of truth for skill overview, workflow, and cross-skill concerns, deferring runtime behavior to each SKILL.md.

visual-planner renders PLAN.md to an untracked PLAN.html via deterministic render_plan.py; --summarize is run by writing-plans, at each wave boundary, and by finishing before the shipped commit, and a standalone --review overlay uses an emitted file list plus a .plan-review.json sidecar.
session-retro is user-invoked only, maps session friction to environment levers, edits nothing, and routes approved items to improvement-backlog rows, a feature-intake task, or compound.

finishing-branch-contract.test.sh pins the finish skill's resolver contract, receipt gate flags, PR-only safety boundary, the ready_to_merge producer with || true, the open-questions check, and the SC history check.

brainstorming asks the open-decision frontier (decisions whose prerequisites are settled) in one numbered round with a recommended answer per question, finds facts itself instead of asking the user, records a twice-unanswered decision's recommendation as an assumption, and repeats rounds until the frontier is empty and the user confirms shared understanding.

diagnosing-bugs runs all six gated phases on every lane with no cause-known shortcut, creates lane isolation before Phase 1 (fix/<slug> branch from a shared branch on tiny, using-git-worktrees on normal/high-risk), and writes specs/<slug>/diagnosis.md.

diagnosing-bugs requires a task-reviewer spec_verdict pass and quality_verdict approved on diagnosis.md before Phase 5; on the tiny lane Phase 5 commits a red test at the Seam before the fix, while normal and high-risk lanes continue the lane route with diagnosis.md as input.

writing-plans gives every task a Seams: line and, when diagnosis.md exists, copies its Seam: exactly into the fix task; subagent-driven-development compares the two seam points before dispatching the fix task and escalates after a second mismatch.
When diagnosis.md exists, compound's bug track takes its root cause from the Confirmed: hypothesis.

scripts/audit_skill_prompts.py fails any registered SKILL.md over 600 words (whole file counted) with a hint pointing to docs/solutions/harness/deletion-test-for-word-ceiling.md, while a skill with an UPSTREAM.md is exempt and only noted.

The deletion-test procedure trims a skill by whole sentences or blocks: delete sentences the model already does by default, move branch-only blocks to references/, never shorten a sentence containing a condition word from check_scope_qualifiers.py's WORDS list, and record leftover sentences as kept long on purpose in SUMMARY.md.

harness-models is a user-invoked skill that runs scripts/apply_model_config.py in show (default), check, or apply mode against harness-models.json, relays output verbatim, never edits harness-models.json, and warns that agent changes may apply only from the next session.

HARNESS.md's lane table lists the normal path as subagent-driven-development alone, whereas feature-intake and the skills/README.md Minimum Viable Path route normal work through using-git-worktrees first and require a branch on every lane.
